description: Delete specific observations from entities in the knowledge graph. Deletion is by content: every occurrence of that content on the entity goes. A batch is not all-or-nothing — the message reports how many were deleted and names the entities that were not found. To replace a content in place use update_observations; to remove the whole entity use delete_entities.

deletions.description: One entry per entity: the entity name and the contents to delete

entityName.description: The name of the entity containing the observations

observations.description: An array of observations to delete

name: delete_observations
title: Delete Observations
